mode: Static committed-source audit only; not implemented or executed. No repo edits/runtime/provider/DB operations.
meaning: SourceBound means every listed required native fixture fact is actually returned by the coordinated same-transaction owner reads and preserved with origin/digest in the new readiness envelope. It is not complete production evaluation binding, eligibility, reviewer context, grant or decision. Missing always has requiredReference=null and explicit reason; associatedPartialFacts cannot satisfy the missing binding. No SamplingInput, sampling projection or partial selection in this cycle.
jsonPathNotation: Aliases decode nested JSON string payloads. Brace expressions abbreviate separately named field paths; [*] denotes each actual element. Every source/plan/packet/receipt version tuple must retain scope and actual source digests in the lossless sidecar. P is a proposed representation only; actual returned typed owner records are the authority.

pathAliases.C: JSON parse of actual cycle05 capture.CanonicalJson; camelCase/named enums.
pathAliases.F: JSON parse of C.$.frozenInputsJson (string); camelCase/named enums.
pathAliases.L: JSON parse of C.$.aiRunLockJson (string); owning AI canonical camelCase/named enums.
pathAliases.A: JSON parse of C.$.aiSnapshotJson (string); owning AI canonical camelCase/named enums.
pathAliases.I: JSON parse of A.$.works[*].work.packetInputJson (string), per exact actual work. Historical attempts also retain A.$.works[*].attempts[*].packetInputJson; preserve/bind any semantically emitted alternate packet bytes.
pathAliases.U: JSON parse of A.$.works[*].attempts[*].receipt.outputJson (string), only actual accepted/succeeded outputs; receipt may be null, output may be null/invalid/rejected. Bind receiptId, attempt, outputDigest and full raw output separately, never supply missing schema from constants.
pathAliases.O: JSON parse of C.$.members[*].occurrences[*].originalJson (string); owning AI canonical camelCase/named enums.
pathAliases.G: JSON parse of C.$.members[*].occurrences[*].generatedFindingJson (string); owning default serializer PascalCase/numeric enums; do not re-label embedded JSON casing/enum representation.
pathAliases.P: Same-transaction owning run.Plan serialized with JsonSerializer.Serialize default (the owning persisted representation, PascalCase/numeric enums). These P paths describe the proposed detached plan addition; cycle05 capture does not contain P and its bytes stay unchanged.

composition: New module orchestrates CaptureAsync then second owning runs.ReadInTransactionAsync on identical existing connection/transaction, while registry/run/AI locks are retained. Compare exact runId/scope/revision/inputDigest/baseline/profile/frozenInputs with capture. Detach/encode actual Plan/CapabilityLock in new envelope; old capture bytes unchanged. Preserve distinct source observation timestamps; no DML/connection/commit/new permission. Do not accept arbitrary earlier capture as current source.
otherContextAbsent: Explicit evaluation/population/sample identity, seed, predecessor, correction cutoff and evaluation date are not provided by these reads. Database observation timestamps are source observations, not evaluation dates.
